scientific_integrity: An exact analytic theorem with supplementary numeric and algebraic checks; no independent mathematical audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one real subspaces and an assumed principal-angle uncertainty bound only.
The optimal objective is the largest row reweighting ratio, not total sample complexity, the exact deviation tail, or an end-to-end least-squares or CP-ALS error.
No optimality uniqueness is asserted outside the one-parameter leverage/uniform mixture family.
Priority remains subject to discovery of equivalent earlier sampling/robust-design formulations.
title: Sharp universal minimax smoothing of reference leverage scores under rank-one drift
